sql:
WITH three_warehouses AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM warehouses
  WHERE name IN ('Atlanta Fulfilment Centre','Reading Fulfilment Centre','Den Haag Fulfilment Centre')
),
adjustments AS (
  SELECT sa.variant_id, sa.reason, sa.created_at, w.name AS warehouse_name
  FROM stock_adjustments sa
  JOIN stock_locations sl ON sl.id = sa.stock_location_id
  JOIN three_warehouses w ON w.id = sl.warehouse_id
  WHERE sa.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND sa.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
variant_info AS (
  SELECT pv.id AS variant_id, pv.sku, pv.name AS variant_name, p.name AS product_name
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN products p ON p.id = pv.product_id
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    a.warehouse_name,
    vi.product_name,
    vi.sku,
    vi.variant_name,
    COUNT(*) AS adjustment_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.reason = 'Missing - suspected theft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_theft_reason,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(a.created_at)) AS distinct_days_affected
  FROM adjustments a
  JOIN variant_info vi ON vi.variant_id = a.variant_id
  GROUP BY a.warehouse_name, vi.product_name, vi.sku, vi.variant_name
)
SELECT
  warehouse_name,
  product_name,
  sku,
  variant_name,
  adjustment_count,
  pct_theft_reason,
  distinct_days_affected,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_distinct_variants
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY adjustment_count DESC, warehouse_name ASC, sku ASC
LIMIT 50
note: Grain is warehouse × product variant as requested; adjustment_count/pct_theft_reason/distinct_days_affected are computed per variant per warehouse over 2025 stock_adjustments at the three named sites. Added a total_distinct_variants column (window count before the 50-row cap) so the analyst can see the full count of variants with discrepancies even though only the top 50 by adjustment_count are printed.
